title: CLARITY Act Likely Dead Until 2027, Top Crypto Lawmakers Warn
content: Bitcoin Magazine CLARITY Act Likely Dead Until 2027, Top Crypto Lawmakers Warn House Financial Services Chairman French Hill said the CLARITY Act's chances in the lame-duck session are "not high," pushing the crypto market structure bill toward a Democratic-led Congress. title: Global Securities Watchdog Warns of Quantum Computing Threat to Blockchains and Finance
content: Bitcoin Magazine Global Securities Watchdog Warns of Quantum Computing Threat to Blockchains and Finance The global securities regulators’ body says quantum computers could break today’s cryptography, and that moving blockchains to quantum-resistant security will be especially hard. This post Global Securities Watchdog Warns of Quantum Computing Threat to Blockchains and Finance first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Ledger Finds Tampered Hardware Wallets in Berlin, Probes Two in Dubai
content: Bitcoin Magazine Ledger Finds Tampered Hardware Wallets in Berlin, Probes Two in Dubai Ledger confirmed tampered hardware wallets in Berlin and is investigating two more in Dubai, widening a probe into spy implants that steal recovery phrases. title: Coinbase Launches U.S. Spot Margin Trading With Up to 10x Leverage
content: Bitcoin Magazine Coinbase Launches U.S. Spot Margin Trading With Up to 10x Leverage Coinbase opened crypto spot margin trading in the U.S. with up to 10x leverage, but only for eligible contract participants with more than $10 million invested. title: Russia’s Central Bank to Let Retail Investors Trade Bitcoin on Margin
content: Bitcoin Magazine Russia’s Central Bank to Let Retail Investors Trade Bitcoin on Margin A Bank of Russia official said retail investors will be able to trade crypto on margin up to 300,000 rubles, with the first crypto funds for qualified investors expected in 2027. This post Russia’s Central Bank to Let Retail Investors Trade Bitcoin on Margin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
